---
title: "Batch Correction"
---

Batch correction with cyCombine, including all-in-one and modular workflows,
plus diagnostic evaluation and visualisation.

## All-in-one workflow

### `sw_correct_prepare` {#sw_correct_prepare}

Prepare data for batch correction.

#### Usage

```r
sw_correct_prepare(ff_list, sample_meta, markers, cofactor = 6000)
```

#### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `ff_list` | Named list of `flowFrame` objects. |
| `sample_meta` | Data frame with columns: `file`, `sample`, `batch`, `condition`. |
| `markers` | Character vector of marker names. |
| `cofactor` | Arcsinh cofactor (default: 6000 for spectral flow). |

#### Details

Converts a list of `flowFrame` objects into a single tibble with
arcsinh-transformed marker values and required metadata columns for cyCombine.

#### Value

A `tibble` with one row per cell, arcsinh-transformed marker columns, and
metadata columns (`sample`, `batch`, `condition`).

---

### `sw_correct_run` {#sw_correct_run}

All-in-one batch correction.

#### Usage

```r
sw_correct_run(uncorrected, markers, covar = NULL, label = NULL,
                 xdim = 8, ydim = 8, rlen = 10, norm_method = "scale",
                 seed = 42, ...)
```

#### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `uncorrected` | A `data.frame`/`tibble` with a `batch` column and marker columns. |
| `markers` | Character vector of marker column names to correct. |
| `covar` | Optional covariate column name(s) for ComBat. |
| `label` | Optional pre-computed cluster labels. |
| `xdim` | SOM grid x-dimension (default: 8). |
| `ydim` | SOM grid y-dimension (default: 8). |
| `rlen` | SOM training length (default: 10). |
| `norm_method` | Normalisation method (default: `"scale"`). |
| `seed` | Random seed (default: 42). |
| `...` | Additional arguments passed to `cyCombine::batch_correct()`. |

#### Details

All-in-one wrapper for cyCombine that normalises, clusters with a
Self-Organising Map, and applies ComBat-based batch correction.

#### Value

A `tibble` with batch-corrected marker values.

---

### `sw_correct_evaluate_quick` {#sw_correct_evaluate_quick}

Quick evaluation of batch correction quality.

#### Usage

```r
sw_correct_evaluate_quick(uncorrected, corrected, markers)
```

#### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `uncorrected` | Original tibble (before correction). |
| `corrected` | Corrected tibble (after correction). |
| `markers` | Character vector of marker names. |

#### Details

Computes per-marker MAD of batch medians before and after correction. For
richer diagnostics, see `sw_correct_evaluate_emd()` and `sw_correct_evaluate_mad()`.

#### Value

A named list: `emd`, `mad`, `improved` (logical), `emd_reduction_pct`.

---

## Modular workflow

The modular workflow provides finer control: normalise → cluster → correct.

### `sw_correct_normalize` {#sw_correct_normalize}

Normalise data for batch correction.

#### Usage

```r
sw_correct_normalize(df, markers, norm_method = "scale", ...)
```

#### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `df` | A `data.frame`/`tibble` with marker columns and a `batch` column. |
| `markers` | Character vector of marker column names. |
| `norm_method` | Normalisation method (default: `"scale"`). |
| `...` | Additional arguments. |

#### Details

Applies per-batch normalisation to marker columns, preparing data for SOM
clustering. First step of the modular workflow.

#### Value

A `tibble` with normalised marker values.

---

### `sw_correct_som` {#sw_correct_som}

Create a Self-Organising Map for batch correction.

#### Usage

```r
sw_correct_som(df, markers, xdim = 8, ydim = 8, rlen = 10, seed = 42, ...)
```

#### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `df` | A `data.frame`/`tibble`. |
| `markers` | Character vector of marker column names. |
| `xdim` | SOM grid x-dimension (default: 8). |
| `ydim` | SOM grid y-dimension (default: 8). |
| `rlen` | SOM training length (default: 10). |
| `seed` | Random seed (default: 42). |
| `...` | Additional arguments. |

#### Details

Clusters cells using a Self-Organising Map. The resulting labels are passed
to `sw_correct_apply()` so that ComBat is applied within each cluster. Second
step of the modular workflow.

#### Value

An integer vector of cluster labels, one per row in `df`.

---

### `sw_correct_apply` {#sw_correct_apply}

Apply ComBat batch correction with pre-computed labels.

#### Usage

```r
sw_correct_apply(df, label, markers, covar = NULL, parametric = TRUE, ...)
```

#### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `df` | A `data.frame`/`tibble` with a `batch` column and marker columns. |
| `label` | Integer vector of cluster labels (from `sw_correct_som()`). |
| `markers` | Character vector of marker column names. |
| `covar` | Optional covariate column name(s). |
| `parametric` | Logical; use parametric ComBat (default: `TRUE`). |
| `...` | Additional arguments. |

#### Details

Runs ComBat batch correction within each cluster defined by the supplied
labels. Final step of the modular workflow.

#### Value

A `tibble` with batch-corrected marker values.

---

## Batch effect detection and evaluation

### `sw_correct_detect_batch` {#sw_correct_detect_batch}

Detect batch effects.

#### Usage

```r
sw_correct_detect_batch(df, markers, out_dir = NULL, downsample = NULL,
                       seed = 42, ...)
```

#### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `df` | A `data.frame`/`tibble` with a `batch` column. |
| `markers` | Character vector of marker column names. |
| `out_dir` | Optional output directory for plots. |
| `downsample` | Optional number of cells to downsample to. |
| `seed` | Random seed (default: 42). |
| `...` | Additional arguments. |

#### Details

Produces diagnostic density plots, per-marker EMD scores, and an MDS plot of
median marker expression across batches.

#### Value

A list of `ggplot` objects (when `out_dir = NULL`), or `NULL` invisibly after
saving to `out_dir`.

---

### `sw_correct_emd` {#sw_correct_emd}

Compute Earth Mover's Distance.

#### Usage

```r
sw_correct_emd(df, markers, cell_col = "label", batch_col = "batch",
               binSize = 0.1, ...)
```

#### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `df` | A `data.frame`/`tibble` with `label` and `batch` columns. |
| `markers` | Character vector of marker column names. |
| `cell_col` | Cluster label column (default: `"label"`). |
| `batch_col` | Batch column (default: `"batch"`). |
| `binSize` | Bin size for EMD computation (default: 0.1). |
| `...` | Additional arguments. |

#### Details

Computes EMD between batch distributions for each marker within each SOM
cluster.

#### Value

A named list of EMD matrices (per cluster, per marker).

---

### `sw_correct_evaluate_emd` {#sw_correct_evaluate_emd}

Evaluate batch correction with EMD.

#### Usage

```r
sw_correct_evaluate_emd(uncorrected, corrected, markers, cell_col = "label",
                batch_col = "batch", binSize = 0.1, ...)
```

#### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `uncorrected` | Original data with `label` and `batch` columns. |
| `corrected` | Corrected data with matching `label` and `batch` columns. |
| `markers` | Character vector of marker column names. |
| `cell_col` | Cluster label column (default: `"label"`). |
| `batch_col` | Batch column (default: `"batch"`). |
| `binSize` | Bin size for EMD (default: 0.1). |
| `...` | Additional arguments. |

#### Details

Compares Earth Mover's Distance distributions before and after batch
correction.

#### Value

A named list: `violin`, `scatter`, `reduction`, `emd`.

---

### `sw_correct_evaluate_mad` {#sw_correct_evaluate_mad}

Evaluate batch correction with MAD.

#### Usage

```r
sw_correct_evaluate_mad(uncorrected, corrected, markers, cell_col = "label",
                batch_col = "batch", ...)
```

#### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `uncorrected` | Original data with `label` and `batch` columns. |
| `corrected` | Corrected data with matching `label` and `batch` columns. |
| `markers` | Character vector of marker column names. |
| `cell_col` | Cluster label column (default: `"label"`). |
| `batch_col` | Batch column (default: `"batch"`). |
| `...` | Additional arguments. |

#### Details

Computes Median Absolute Deviation of batch medians within SOM clusters,
before and after correction.

#### Value

A named list: `score`, `mad`.

---

## Visualisation

### `sw_plot_batch_densities` {#sw_plot_batch_densities}

Plot marker density distributions by batch.

#### Usage

```r
sw_plot_batch_densities(uncorrected, corrected, markers, filename = NULL,
                        ncol = 6, ...)
```

#### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `uncorrected` | Original data. |
| `corrected` | Corrected data. |
| `markers` | Character vector of marker column names. |
| `filename` | Optional output file path. |
| `ncol` | Number of columns in the plot grid (default: 6). |
| `...` | Additional arguments passed to `cyCombine::plot_density()`. |

#### Details

Creates density ridgeline plots comparing marker distributions across
batches, before and after correction.

#### Value

A `ggplot` object (or list of objects), invisibly when `filename` is given.

---

### `sw_plot_batch_dimred` {#sw_plot_batch_dimred}

Plot dimensionality reduction coloured by batch.

#### Usage

```r
sw_plot_batch_dimred(df, markers, type = "umap", name = "Batch",
                     seed = 42, ...)
```

#### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `df` | A `data.frame`/`tibble` with marker and `batch` columns. |
| `markers` | Character vector of marker column names. |
| `type` | Dimensionality reduction type: `"umap"` or `"pca"`. |
| `name` | Colour legend title (default: `"Batch"`). |
| `seed` | Random seed (default: 42). |
| `...` | Additional arguments passed to `cyCombine::plot_dimred()`. |

#### Details

Creates a UMAP or PCA projection coloured by batch to visualise batch effects
or correction success.

#### Value

A `ggplot` object.
